name: com.wgllss.dynamic.host.lib.provider.WXPluginContentProvider
description: Wgllss Dynamic Host exposes this provider for content used by dynamically loaded plug-ins. When the host app or a plug-in requests content, it routes the request to the plug-in registered for that path.
disableEffect: Plug-ins that use the shared content address will lose that data access and may not work fully.
